HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:AHC:66649 Court No. - 64 Case :- CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 275 of 2024 Applicant :- Sandeep Maurya Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Pradeep Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Vinod Kumar Yadav Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
Matter is taken up in the revised call.

By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.0483 of 2023 at Police Station-Mehnagar, District-Azamgarh under Sections 376, 452, 354A,
506, 380 IPC and Section 67 of the Information Technology Act.
The applicant is in jail since 30.11.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 14.12.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Pradeep Yadav, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Vinod Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the Sandeep Maurya vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116410105/
1 informant and Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1. Delay of 10 months in lodgement of the F.I.R. in the facts of this case is fatal to the prosecution case.
2. The victim and the applicant were intimate and had consensual physical relations.
3. The F.I.R. is the result of the relationship going awry.
4.

entities.text: Sandeep Maurya vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant never captured any indecent videos or photos of the victim nor circulated them.
No such videos or photos were recovered from the applicant.
5. The principal offenders who had circulated the photographs/indecent videos were captured in the CCTV footage by the cameras of the neighbourhood.
However, the police did not retrieve the CCTV nor conduct appropriate investigations.
6. Medical evidence to corroborate commission of rape by the applicant with the victim has not been produced by the prosecution.
7. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from the instant case.
8. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Sandeep Maurya be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

The learned trial court is directed to fix the sureties after due application of mind in light of the judgement rendered by this Court in Arvind Singh v. State of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt.
(Application U/S 482 No.2613 of 2023).
